
{{alias}}( x, y )
    Computes the cumulative maximum value of an array.

    Parameters
    ----------
    x: Array<number>|TypedArray
        Input array.

    y: Array<number>|TypedArray
        Output array.

    Returns
    -------
    out: Array<number>|TypedArray
        Output array.

    Examples
    --------
    > var x = [ 1.0, -2.0, 2.0 ];
    > var y = [ 0.0, 0.0, 0.0 ];
    > {{alias}}( x, y )
    [ 1.0, 1.0, 2.0 ]

    See Also
    --------
